script: Some planets have no star at all. They are called rogue planets, and they drift alone through the galaxy. Many were probably flung out of their home solar systems. There could be billions of them in the Milky Way. Without a sun, their surfaces would be dark and frozen. Follow WonderBytes for more facts that sound fake but are true.
